text:
maria: quick FYI — noticed eu-west1 PG-queue drained twice this morning during the marketing spike, pods got preempted, and burst slab didn't replenish fast enough
sam: saw the alert, was about to ping — looks like slab pacing capped new allocations because network egress hit 75% on a subset of nodes
jia: can you paste the autoscaler logs? curious if the backoff was due to node readiness or the network governor
maria: here's the relevant snippet from the scaler log:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] scale_decision: target+6 slab_pacing=120s network_score=0.78
[2026-03-17T08:12:05Z] apply_capacity: delayed, reason=network_backpressure, retry=30s
[2026-03-17T08:13:40Z] fallback: allocate_low_bandwidth_nodes only 2/6
```
oliver: so slab_pacing 120s is too conservative for sudden 3x qps bursts. we've configured it to avoid oscillation, but the networking constraint made it worse
neha: infrastructure note — eu-west1 has an ongoing SR with provider about intermittent cross-rack egress saturation during promotional traffic windows
autoscale-bot: alert: slab_pacing_delay triggered for pool=pg-eu-west1, duration=85s, nodes_blocked=4
sam: proposal: add a fast-path for short high-confidence bursts — allow ephemeral slab override for <=90s if health checks pass and global egress <85%
jia: +1 but need guardrails: limit override to X GPU-hours per hour per customer and revert if packet-loss >0.5%
maria: concrete config sketch I tested locally:
```
scaling:
  slab_pacing_seconds: 120
  burst_override:
    enabled: true
    max_duration: 90
    max_gpu_hours_per_hour: 10
    net_threshold_pct: 85
    rollback_on_loss_pct: 0.5
```
neha: also make region-aware: if provider SR active, lower max_gpu_hours to 4 and route to eu-north1 as fallback
oliver: ops question — how do we track cost impact? need per-customer counters and hourly aggregates so finance can reconcile burst usage
maria: telemetry emitted in my test: `burst.override=true, burst_gpu_hours=3.6, cost_estimate_usd=4.32` — we can surface that in Console under insights > burst-usage
sam: also need safety: throttle per-az not just per-region so single switch outage doesn't wipe out fallback
jia: agree. add az_quota: 2 and global_quota: 12
maria: updated config sketch:
```
burst_override:
  enabled: true
  max_duration: 90
  max_gpu_hours_per_hour: 10
  az_quota: 2
  global_quota: 12
  net_threshold_pct: 85
  rollback_on_loss_pct: 0.5
```
neha: let's also have automated post-burst evaluation: run quick QoS tests (latency P95, packet-loss) and if degradation > threshold, flag rollback and create incident ticket
oliver: timeline? can we ship a canary to non-prod today and EU next week
sam: I'll open a PR with the autoscaler changes and unit tests. canary plan: non-prod 2h soak, eu-west1 night window, eu fallback configured
maria: I'll wire telemetry and small UI card in Console for burst insights
jao: FYI from finance — need a new billing metric code for ephemeral bursts, pinged billing-api team
jen: +1 on audit trail, require operator approval for manual overrides outside the policy
autoscale-bot: task created: autoscale/pr-542 by @sam assigned to @jia @maria
